Name: Pella Rowan - The Hearth Medic
Author: AleksSmash2020
Description:
Pella Rowan is a new non-romance NPC for Stardew Valley who works around the clinic and gives ordinary forage and flowers a small, readable purpose. This is not another general shop and it is not an infinite money or healing system. Pella's loop is built around four pre-authored consultation cards, each with a clear two-ingredient match and a limited follow-up reward.

[b]How the loop works[/b]

Meet Pella, read the current consultation card, gather the two listed vanilla ingredients, and bring them to the corresponding consultation event. The requested ingredients are consumed when the consultation is completed. A successful card awards a small preparation or journal-related reward and can also provide Care Tokens. The cards are designed as deterministic, hand-authored objectives: you always know what the request is asking for instead of guessing at a random quest generator.

[b]The four consultations[/b]

The release includes Rainy-Day Warmth, Orchard Nerves, Night Shift and Winter Window. Together they cover different combinations of ordinary forage and flowers while keeping the scale intentionally modest. Rewards include Quiet Tea, Garden Salve, Rest Kit and the Hearth Journal, with limited availability rather than an endlessly repeatable resource printer.

[b]Friendship and content[/b]

Pella has an original portrait, overworld sprite, schedule, gift tastes and daily dialogue in English and Russian. Friendship events at 2, 5 and 8 hearts develop her story around care, boundaries and the work of a small clinic. The journal and consultation rewards give the relationship a practical progression without adding romance or spouse systems.

[b]Installation and compatibility[/b]

Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then place `Pella Rowan - The Hearth Medic` in the Stardew Valley `Mods` folder. This is a Content Patcher pack for Stardew Valley 1.6 and includes no custom DLL. It does not replace vanilla NPC assets, add a new map, create a shop, change combat or fishing, or alter economy values. Clinic/town schedule and event placement are static data assumptions and should be treated accordingly.

[b]Credits and disclosure[/b]

This release contains original content and original visual assets created with AI assistance. AI-Generated Content is tagged honestly on the page.
